author: Andrew Dimitra
text: Honest guy treats everybody respect don’t charge an arm and a leg reasonable price shows up on time gets everything done all around. Had a great time with this company. I will recommend for anybody that needs their septic system pumped out. Give him a holler respectable guy.

author: Darrell Barnes
text: Couldn't be more satisfied with the level of service. I called because our tanks were full and needed someone to pump them out. Shay was honest and let me know when he could reasonably make it out and kept to his word. He even provided the quote for the service over the phone so I knew what to expect. If you need your septic serviced, call these guys. He even made recommendations to prolong the time between him having to come out and pump again. Thanks so much for the excellent customer service.

author: Ruth Rasmussen
text: Used another company for over 20 years but now they've raised their prices to dig up access to septic tanks. Found DL3 online and they're over $100 lower.  Jordon came out & only charged to dig up 1 of our 3 tanks. All 3 tanks pumped quickly. Talked to Dan/Dave? several times who sent me info when we were still having trouble.  After telling us we needed a new system, he recommended a plumber who could connect us to city sewer several feet away. They spent so much time answering questions, explaining our system and listening to our concerns.  Way above and beyond.  Best in N. TX.

author: DL
text: Great Company. Jordan spent time to help me find my tanks. One was buried under my walkway so he and Dan advised me on the best options for access. They came out same day each time I needed them and the price was very fair.  I called 2 other companies that never replied and I'm glad they didn't. These guys are great.  Use them with confidence.

author: Bernie Brown
text: Unfortunately, I don't remember the name of the gentleman that helped us out today.  Signature looks like Jordan.  But, what I will never forget is the very courteous and speedy service.  I'd spent a few hours uncovering one of the tanks, waiting over 10 days for another company (their trucks were both in the shop, not their fault), and was getting worried about putting my deck back together so it would be safe for my family and grandkids to make the trek over to the pool.  The other company had agreed to find a "partner" to assist due to the long period of time we'd gone since the sewer first backed up (Memorial Day weekend).  I got a phone call at 9:22 am. By 11:00 am, the work was complete.  He uncovered the second tank, had both tanks pumped, and was ready to go in less than an hour and a half.  Fantastic service.  Could not ask for better.  I will be calling DL3 first if I have problems in the future.  Always go local. Always go with a small business.  It's important.
